items.title: Halliburton, TechnipFMC, Antero Resources, APA Corporation, and Transocean Stocks Trade Up, What You Need To Know
items.summary: A number of stocks jumped in the morning session after Brent crude failed to break below $80 and rebounded to the mid-$80s, as traders kept a geopolitical risk premium priced into oil despite ongoing Strait of Hormuz negotiations. Over the previous 24 hours, the UAE-vessel incident reversed the earlier price drop that had assumed a path to de-escalation. items.summary: MUSA's Q2 earnings surge 53.1% as stronger fuel economics, higher volumes and merchandise gains boost results and raise 2026 earnings power.

items.title: Delek US Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Refining Margins

items.title: Crescent Q2 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates, Rise Y/Y

items.title: What Are Wall Street Analysts' Target Price for Halliburton Stock?
items.summary: Halliburton has rallied better than the broader market over the past year, and analysts are fairly bullish about its future growth projections.
